scope: Design and prototype the streaming download-to-preparation bridge: connect the modinst_download file-sink path to the mb_archive intake path so large archives do not need a second full copy and preparation can begin as early as the source contract allows. Prototype the simpler approach (download writes one private temp file; a threshold-gated handoff promotes the exact inode to mb_archive_source_v1); document the full callback-based incremental-feed design as future work.
method: New owned files only under this directory (owned/, test/, design/, build/). Host-side build/test only (macOS, PS5IO_HOST semantics, no network, no console contact, no nested subagents). Real pinned intake.c + libarchive + mbedtls are linked read-only into the host test to prove the handoff feeds the genuine scanner.
